rules.seed_derivation: first 64 bits big-endian of SHA-256 of sandwich-development.1|field|integer_snr|motion components formatted .8g; stored as decimal string
rules.truth: old nearest ePSF, fixed source amplitudes generated by frozen injected_frames
rules.noise: fresh field/case PCG64 seeds; native independent Gaussian variance, paired across methods; no source shot noise
rules.point_estimator: unchanged continuous padded target 0.10; 5 starts, 2 IRLS rounds, nuisance profiles and common single-source quality reference

sandwich_rules.correction: CR1p N/(N-2) for two profiled centroid parameters; empirical after nuisance profiling

rules.mode_diagnostic: five starts on fixed-final-weight objective, at the frozen point and nearby modes; no point replacement
rules.registration: separate centroid-only and centroid-plus-registration; registration fixed in generator; no nominal total-coverage claim
rules.qualification: three opened fields only; empirical fixed-final-IRLS sandwich, ten clusters typical, no derivative of robust weights, no physical PSF validation

limitations: Point estimates unchanged by covariance method; new-noise point fits have no previous paired cache
quality and point validity are retained from frozen fitter; total amplitude is not present in its public epoch record
conditional on final IRLS weights; no physical PSF validation, source shot noise, or simulated registration errors
